caption: Lightning strikes a dry hillside, and after the flash a small patch of grass smoulders and smokes.

sa.check: A lightning bolt strikes the hillside.
After the flash a small patch of grass smoulders and smokes.
The smoking patch is at the point where the bolt struck.
The bolt and flash come first and the smoke follows.

pc.expect: The bolt and flash are brief and gone; the smoke appears at the strike point only afterwards and grows from there; the bolt does not remain.
pc.fail: The bolt stands as a steady lit line for the rest of the clip; or smoke rises from the patch before the bolt arrives; or the smoke shrinks back into the ground; or the patch glows like a lamp after the bolt is gone.

pc.expect: The hillside, its grass, rocks and any trees are the same before and after the flash; the only new thing is smoke at the strike point.
pc.fail: Rocks or trees appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the hill changes shape; or a second smoking patch appears where no bolt struck; or a burnt object appears at the strike point that was not there.

pc.expect: The smoke rises from the patch and drifts upward and away; anything thrown up by the strike falls back to the ground.
pc.fail: The smoke sinks and flows down the slope like water; or hangs as a fixed shape; or soil or grass thrown up by the strike rises and stays aloft.

pc.expect: The bolt is a jagged, branching bright line with a main channel from the sky to the strike point.
pc.fail: The bolt is a perfectly straight beam; or a smooth wave; or a wide glowing tube; or a bolt that hangs in mid-air not reaching the hillside while the patch starts smoking.

pc.expect: The ground stays ground: the bolt ends at the surface and does not pass through it, and the hillside stays whole.
pc.fail: The bolt continues below the surface as a lit line under the ground; or the hillside splits open; or the strike point turns into a hole that swallows the grass; or the ground becomes transparent.

pc.expect: The grass colour, the sky and the ground keep their colours apart from the flash and the scorched patch.
pc.fail: The grass changes colour away from the strike point; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash; or the ground changes colour over the whole slope.
